+## First capability checkpoint and bounded diagnostic plan
+
+2026-11-02 — accepted diagnostic plan, agent judgment. Fresh main is
+`8d2f994c3ac53c1849bd2b68927059d9c20c99f0`. The branch/ownership audit found
+only this run's main and SPN-098 commits within two hours; the SPN-090 owner chat
+and remote head remain unchanged and idle, with its recorded provider capability
+prerequisites still unavailable. SPN-133 is the scoped prerequisite investigation
+for the active top eligible SPN-098 merge, not a waiver or a reordered fixed queue.
+
+The failed desktop idle flush held six items in each native cache after 310.4 ms
+of quiet. Nearby capacity flushes were 3.0 and 2.2 ms. The failed main mobile
+capacity flush held 32/32 items; adjacent flushes were 8.7 and 8.9 ms. Existing
+heap snapshots bracket whole runs and cannot attribute either interval. Both
+unprofiled failures therefore remain unclassified. The native paired call includes
+history composition/publication and collaboration composition/publication; the
+current observer measures that entire synchronous call, including subscribers.
+
+Predeclare one diagnostic profile sample per preset (desktop and mobile), each
+with a fresh profile, the existing complete 16-paragraph workload and unchanged
+throttle, source `8d2f994c`, pinned runtime/browser and no retry. Use the existing
+profile case and content/Undo/Redo checks. Add a bounded Chromium trace spanning
+typing and drain, with a clock marker to align native flush metrics, and retain
+the existing CPU profile plus source maps. This is diagnostic-only: profiling
+and tracing change timing, and neither sample can replace ordinary acceptance.
+The hypothesis is that native composition/publication or a runtime pause explains
+the tails; the trace must distinguish them rather than assuming GC. If no slow
+interval is observed, report the sample's limitation and use existing allocation
+or semantic evidence to choose the next bounded step, not repeated timing runs.
+
+Trace collection must preserve partial evidence and fail explicitly if incomplete,
+oversized or timed out. Keep the diagnostic helper/workflow on an archival helper
+branch, outside the implementation PR. Record the exact source and instrumentation
+diff; never mutate the immutable runtime checkout silently or publish credentials.
+Current built-in profiles can inform attribution but do not retroactively identify
+an untraced failure. No production algorithm change has been selected.

+The first private `npm ci` was resource-aborted at memory pressure 2, process-tree
+RSS 679.45 MiB after 2.039 s. Task-owned workers exited; the partial installation

+Read-only source/evidence inspection continues within the shared watchdog policy.

+## First collection failure and narrower trace
+
+2026-11-02 — accepted diagnostic adjustment, agent judgment. Helper
+`97d5b8202cdedca2277d4ba77455214d2f85f127`, run 41446158031 attempt 1,
+executed the declared desktop/mobile profile samples against runtime `8d2f994c`.
+Both exceeded the unchanged 64 MiB trace-retention cap and failed collection
+before final content/Undo/Redo verification. Neither is a passing test or a
+completed trace. [Full first artifacts, logs and collection inventory](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/tree/e6eb83187b1a7c4d0328e5f6330d5a2f33c82f89/docs/review-assets/spn-133-first-diagnostic)
+are immutable; partial traces remain explicitly incomplete.
+
+The desktop prefix contains 270,344 complete events plus one truncated line and
+only the first 27.6 seconds of a 64.4-second trace. General FunctionCall and
+v8.callFunction events account for 37.7 MB, with timer/layout/frame events making
+up most of the rest. This demonstrates collection volume, not the original
+latency cause. The native mobile slow group crosses a paragraph boundary; the
+desktop six-character idle group does not. Neither observation proves attribution.
+
+Predeclare one additional profile per preset after changing instrumentation:
+retain only GC and user-timing categories, and add explicit timing spans around
+the exact pinned native history/collaboration methods. Guard both ES/CJS builds
+against the existing full-file patch hashes, preserve the method bodies and
+return/error behavior, and record every wrapper plus instrumented-file hash.
+The helper is still archival diagnostic code, not a proposed production patch.
+Keep the complete workload, throttle, 300-second case timeout, 64 MiB cap,
+30-second trace-collection deadline and zero retries unchanged. Collect native
+content/Undo/Redo results even if trace completeness ultimately fails; trace
+incompleteness must still fail the diagnostic. This is a justified collection
+repair, not a retry of the original unprofiled acceptance assertion. A narrow
+trace can identify observed GC/native phase overlap but cannot measure all
+rendering or scheduler activity and cannot retrospectively explain an untraced run.

+## Narrow trace result and native composition checkpoint
+
+2026-11-02 — accepted result and effort reassessment, agent judgment with
+independent nonimplementing diagnostic review by `/root/native_registration_review_a`.
+Helper `4a6f59cefda1be85775431eb94518c138dcddbeb`, run 41447339129 attempt 1,
+completed the one declared sample per preset against runtime `8d2f994c`.
+Both complete JSON traces match their hashes and contain ordered sender clock

+## Compose only the qualified leading prefix
+
+2026-11-02 — accepted implementation candidate, agent judgment under the backlog
+run delegation. Runtime acceptance and independent merge review are still pending.
+[Complete narrow traces and independent analysis](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/tree/3835a0f180770f64d5c3704a1bc5246168a4aee5/docs/review-assets/spn-133-narrow-diagnostic)
+and [bounded offline probes](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/tree/7bb40055401193c409e437fec220dccc70409a8b/docs/review-assets/spn-133-composition-probes)
+retain exact sources, raw captures, hashes and first setup failures. Forced
+balancing matched 64 captured cases, but that finite sample does not justify
+admitting general structural operations. The narrower prefix experiment matched
+320/320 raw action results across both formats, scopes, directions and all 32
+paragraph positions, with unchanged input objects. At paragraph position 19,
+instrumented redo clone allocations fell 10,979 to 8,812 per scope; at position
+31, 10,631 to 3,762. These counts are native clone operations, not total JavaScript
+allocations, browser latency or retrospective attribution of the original tails.
+
+Select prefix composition over broad structural admission or balancing arbitrary
+islands. A single scan applies every existing shape, offset, metadata and marker
+guard, stopping at its first unsupported state. Compose the supported leading
+prefix with the existing balanced tree; apply the original sequential composition
+calls to every remaining state. The prefix's raw output equals its original fold,
+so the tail receives the same accumulator and operations in the same order.
+No unsupported action crosses a new reassociation boundary. Native grouping,
+cache ownership, publication, subscribers and timers remain untouched. Both
+history and collaboration, forward and reversed inverse actions use their own
+prefix. There is no new dependency, replacement package or Pro code access.
+
+Preserve the original fold for partial prefixes shorter than four. A new
+three-state malformed-marker case exposed four extra clone allocations (23,248
+versus 23,244 across the paired flush) despite exact output parity. Its bounded
+counter diagnostic confirmed all six malformed marker values in ES/CJS. The
+minimum avoids that measured regression; entirely eligible small groups retain
+the previous behavior. This changes the implementation rather than weakening a
+runtime budget. Paragraph/marker tests retain exact work equality for short
+partial prefixes and real allocation reduction with prior-patch negative controls
+for longer ones.
+
+Keep the exact SPN-132 helper as the shared qualification source and derive the
+prefix-returning helper through explicit transformations, avoiding duplicated
+field guards. Tests pin both previous complete patched builds by SHA-256,
+recover the fully hash-verified upstream original, accept exact upgrades from
+both earlier patches, and reject partial/unknown edits before writing either
+format. The installer tests only write disposable fixture directories.
+
+Owner and Collaborator gain reduced native composition work without changing
+content, formatting, Undo/Redo or shared operation order. Link guest retains
+existing permissions and equivalent allowed-edit behavior. Operator retains the
+small pinned patch, auditable upgrade boundary and all existing acceptance gates;
+original untraced tails remain unclassified, so fresh acceptance is mandatory
+and the work reduction must not be called proof of their individual cause.
+
+### Implementation validation checkpoint
+
+The private SPN-133 installation remains resource-aborted and was moved intact
+to `/tmp/spn133-review/node_modules-aborted-first`. Local focused tests use a
+symlink to the previously validated private SPN-098 dependencies read-only;

+
+After that repair, `node --test scripts/dependencies/patch-univer-docs.test.ts`
+passed all 180 tests (4.724 seconds; watchdog 4.756 seconds, peak 477.7 MiB).
+Coverage includes all paragraph positions with native Enter-style trailing

+structural controls and rich unsupported metadata, raw publication/own-undefined

+
+The retained acceptance limits are desktop flush p95 16 ms / maximum 50 ms and

+
+## Safe slice and retained idle-flush obligation

+2026-11-02 — accepted scope revision after independent nonimplementing reviews

+
+The delivered SPN-133 slice is reduced native composition work in mixed groups,

+neither the prefix improvement nor a later green sample closes the idle defect.
+SPN-098 PR #227 remains draft and blocked on this obligation plus its own eventual

+`3233f9374c9dc028094f548b308a3f9dda3265ca`, tested merge

+125260142761, plain-2 attempt 0: one idle flush, six history and collaboration
+items, 310.4 ms quiet, p95/max 34.300000000046566 ms against desktop p95 16 ms.
+Nearby capacity intervals were 3.0/2.2 ms; exact content/Undo/Redo passed and
+recorded browser errors/reloads were empty. Final completion was absent after

+The [completed narrow diagnostic](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/tree/3835a0f180770f64d5c3704a1bc5246168a4aee5/docs/review-assets/spn-133-narrow-diagnostic)

+It had ordered clock anchors, all 66 flushes/132 history-collaboration spans and
+complete content/Undo/Redo. It did not reproduce or explain the original tail;

+repair if needed, unchanged unprofiled acceptance and integration into blocked

+
+## Test plan and capability checkpoint
+
+First retain a deterministic old/current six-state paired-publication and
+primitive-count proof. That establishes the unchanged implementation boundary,
+not the cause or latency of the original event. Existing instrumentation measures
+the whole synchronous `flushPendingChanges` call including subscribers; there is
+no asynchronous wait inside that measured interval and no identified measurement
+bug. Its wall-clock timing correctly includes a runtime pause if one occurs.
+
+Further browser diagnostics require a new discriminating plan before execution.
+A possible bounded experiment is one old/candidate full-workload pair with exact
+final-cache fingerprints and separately bracketed composition and synchronous
+publication/subscriber phases, aligned with GC/scheduling evidence. Assess its
+incremental value over the existing trace first; do not automatically run it.
+A tail must actually occur for attribution, and a normal sample leaves the cause
+unresolved. Preserve runtime/source/runner identities, collection limits, raw
+results and cleanup. No additional browser run is authorized solely by this
+registration. No threshold relaxation, forced GC or passing assertion rerun is a
+substitute. If the necessary evidence is unavailable, record the concrete limit
+and continue independent eligible backlog work while preserving this open owner.

+# 🕰️ SPN-135 Diagnose native Doc idle-flush latency tails
+
+## Story
+
+As the [Owner](../product/personas.md#owner), I want the final edits in a typing burst to flush within the established latency budget, so that saving and subsequent input stay responsive.
+
+## Scenarios
+
+### The retained idle-flush failure is disposed with evidence
+
+Given SPN-098's preserved first-attempt six-item idle flush exceeded desktop p95,
+When its native composition, synchronous publication and runtime interval are investigated,
+Then a supported repair or measurement disposition preserves equivalent user-visible coverage,
+And fresh first-attempt desktop/mobile workloads meet unchanged idle/capacity budgets with exact content, drain, peer convergence and complete Undo/Redo.
+
+## Rules
+
+- Follow [sustainable testing](../testing.md); preserve the Verify plan and first attempts. [Policy](../implementation/SPN-115.md#guidance-for-every-open-ticket-and-progress-checkpoint), owner 2026-11-01.
+- This retains SPN-133's unresolved desktop obligation, originating in SPN-098 PR #227, CI 41440026607 job 125260142761 plain-2 attempt 0: six/six items, p95/max 34.300000000046566 ms versus desktop p95 16 ms. +for the active top eligible SPN-098 merge, not a waiver or a reordered fixed queue.
+
+The failed desktop idle flush held six items in each native cache after 310.4 ms
+of quiet. Nearby capacity flushes were 3.0 and 2.2 ms. The failed main mobile
+capacity flush held 32/32 items; adjacent flushes were 8.7 and 8.9 ms. Existing
+heap snapshots bracket whole runs and cannot attribute either interval. Both

+history composition/publication and collaboration composition/publication; the

+typing and drain, with a clock marker to align native flush metrics, and retain
+the existing CPU profile plus source maps. This is diagnostic-only: profiling

+The hypothesis is that native composition/publication or a runtime pause explains
+the tails; the trace must distinguish them rather than assuming GC. If no slow
+interval is observed, report the sample's limitation and use existing allocation

+# SPN-135 — native idle-flush latency tails
+
+## Retained obligation from SPN-133
+
+2026-11-02 — accepted scope split, agent judgment under the backlog run's standing
+delegation, following independent nonimplementing reviews by
+`/root/spn133_review_a` and `/root/spn133_review_b`. This records an unresolved
+acceptance obligation; it does not claim a repair, passing runtime check or cause.
+
+The original SPN-133 outcome covered both a mobile capacity maximum and a desktop
+idle p95 failure. Its delivered candidate reduces the already-qualified leading
+prefix's native work before structural/unsupported operations. The original
+six-item desktop idle group is entirely eligible already, so its algorithm and
+work remain unchanged. Both reviewers require this boundary to remain explicit:
+neither the prefix improvement nor a later green sample closes the idle defect.
+SPN-098 PR #227 remains draft and blocked on this obligation plus its own eventual
+current-source acceptance. No feedback code defect or data loss is inferred.
+
+Original source `24e00a783803749b73483457b923dddafee9996c`, base
+`3233f9374c9dc028094f548b308a3f9dda3265ca`, tested merge
+`dbbe5ccaf085ce20b79068d3596a35dcf2142223`, CI 41440026607 job
+125260142761, plain-2 attempt 0: one idle flush, six history and collaboration
+items, 310.4 ms quiet, p95/max 34.300000000046566 ms against desktop p95 16 ms.
+Nearby capacity intervals were 3.0/2.2 ms; exact content/Undo/Redo passed and
+recorded browser errors/reloads were empty. Final completion was absent after
+the failed assertion. [Full immutable original evidence](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/tree/8921e57d7df09ea24a618905bce849d337817850/docs/review-assets/spn-098-native-flush-first-failures).
+
+The [completed narrow diagnostic](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/tree/3835a0f180770f64d5c3704a1bc5246168a4aee5/docs/review-assets/spn-133-narrow-diagnostic)
+observed the same final six-item path at 0.8 ms after the complete typing workload.
+It had ordered clock anchors, all 66 flushes/132 history-collaboration spans and
+complete content/Undo/Redo. It did not reproduce or explain the original tail;
+GC, composition, subscribers and runtime scheduling remain possible, unproven
+attributions. The first broad trace exceeded its collection cap and remains an
+explicit failed collection. All first attempts survive in SPN-133's linked record.
+
+Choose a separately owned XL investigation rather than pretending the mixed-group
+repair completes the whole original outcome. Owner and Collaborator retain both
+responsive editing and complete history/convergence requirements. Link guest
+keeps existing access boundaries and equivalent permitted-edit behavior. Operator
+gets a finite evidence trail, unchanged gates and no speculative production code.
+Remaining work is attribution or equivalent measurement disposition, a justified
+repair if needed, unchanged unprofiled acceptance and integration into blocked
+SPN-098. No estimate implies that closing SPN-133 finishes this follow-up.
+
+## Test plan and capability checkpoint
+
+First retain a deterministic old/current six-state paired-publication and
+primitive-count proof. That establishes the unchanged implementation boundary,
+not the cause or latency of the original event. Existing instrumentation measures
+the whole synchronous `flushPendingChanges` call including subscribers; there is
+no asynchronous wait inside that measured interval and no identified measurement
+bug. Its wall-clock timing correctly includes a runtime pause if one occurs.
+
+Further browser diagnostics require a new discriminating plan before execution.
+A possible bounded experiment is one old/candidate full-workload pair with exact
+final-cache fingerprints and separately bracketed composition and synchronous
+publication/subscriber phases, aligned with GC/scheduling evidence. Assess its
+incremental value over the existing trace first; do not automatically run it.
+A tail must actually occur for attribution, and a normal sample leaves the cause
+unresolved. Preserve runtime/source/runner identities, collection limits, raw
+results and cleanup. No additional browser run is authorized solely by this
+registration. No threshold relaxation, forced GC or passing assertion rerun is a
+substitute. If the necessary evidence is unavailable, record the concrete limit
+and continue independent eligible backlog work while preserving this open owner.
